collection.description: Two siblings who argued shelter beneath the same broad leaf: let them speak first, or give them time.

scene.name: The scene
scene.text: After an argument, two siblings find themselves sheltering beneath the same broad leaf.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: They laugh at how ridiculous their quarrel sounds in the rain.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: Neither is ready to apologize, but they walk home together.
